diagnostic:
Rework of the four implementation-owned findings of the 7ccbc1b..730d6db review, committed at e941b18.

(1) BLOCKER, deleted: handlers/instance.rs::each_slack_offer_names_its_own_door, the fourth handler test no acceptance row records; it only restated the SlackOffer match arms, which the template and the recorded offer table already exercise.

(2) CRITICAL, D10: the I-14 gate now decides inside the write own locked transaction. foundry-store gained Store::store_slack_submission, which takes the instance-integrations lock exclusive, reads the connected-workspace count in that transaction and calls the caller pure gate over it, then performs the one write the gate chose: the fenced save (save_slack_app) or the fenced hold. The pending upsert moved into one private hold_pending_slack_app(tx, app) that both the standalone hold and the gated path use, so the pending fence and upsert keep one owner and the check-arch seal-fence whitelist name is unchanged. The count SQL is one const both the gate and the page read (CONNECTED_SLACK_WORKSPACES). The app side keeps SubmissionDoor as the pure L3 decision in handlers/instance.rs and all sealing in slack_app.rs: store_submission seals both plans (plan_replace and plan_hold_pending) before the lock is taken and passes a gate closure, following the shipped planner/resealer closure shape; the capability trait method save_slack_app and hold_pending_slack_app were replaced by one store_slack_submission, so the submission write has one owner, and the retention test double stub followed mechanically.

(4) MEDIUM, saved_notice: the notice is no longer built from the ?saved= query. SavedNotice now answers a changed app with a one-shot flash in the admin own session (the shipped InstallState::SESSION_KEY shape) and redirects to the page itself with no query; show_instance takes it out as it reads it, so a typed, bookmarked or shared address shows no notice and a reload of the landed page shows the page as it is. The post-redirect-get is kept. A first attempt used a state check instead (notice shown only where the current PageFacts agree); the lane refuted it: in the two-replica scenarios the admin lands on a replica that has not reloaded yet, so a legitimately earned Saved. notice disappeared (us-iis-05 2 of 29 scenarios red). The flash is the other remedy the finding permits and is replica-safe, the session store being Postgres-backed.

(5) LOW: the module doc of handlers/instance.rs says which doors answer a write by redirect - the Slack save, the confirm and the remove - and that Generate and Move answer in place.

No refactor commit was needed: no L1-L4 move was taken apart from the behaviour delta. Oracle, supports and feature records untouched. Finding 3 (L3 law text) belongs to the architect and was not touched here.

Verification in local-dev through scripts/test-in-lima.sh (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false), all on the committed tree: cargo test -p foundry-app --lib 205 passed, exit 0; cargo test -p foundry-store --test iis_instance_store 17 passed, exit 0; cargo xtask check-arch exit 0; eip_lane us-iis-05 29 scenarios all passed, exit 0; eip_lane instance-integration-setup 105 scenarios all passed, exit 0; cargo fmt && cargo xtask smoke printed xtask smoke :: all gates green, exit 0. One earlier smoke run failed at cargo clippy (redundant_closure in store_capabilities.rs) and was fixed before the green run. Not pushed, not tagged.
